recent.text: I'm told Cal Ritchie's assignment to Hamilton is a regular loan, not a conditioning stint. Since Ritchie is waiver-exempt, the #Isles didn't need to designate it as one. Conditioning stints have a 14-day max, while a regular loan gives NYI more flexibility.
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: Just spitballin' Holmstrom-Horvat-Palmieri Maccelli-Ritchie-Barzal Heineman-Schenn-Eklund Three spots for: Pageau, Palat, Duclair, Cizikas, Chaffee Eklund could swap with Palmieri but you hate to break up his chemistry with Schenn #OptionsAreGood
recent.author: Andrew Gross
recent.quoted_text: Assuming Cal Ritchie rejoins #Isles perhaps next week and J-G Pageau's absence from a lower-body injury isn't a long one, which it's not expected to be, I think Mathew Barzal's enthusiasm after last night's game about team's forward depth is very fair.

recent.text: Whether it's a true conditioning stint for Ritchie or something longer, time will tell. The #Isles obviously don't want to waive anyone. But DeBoer said he's playing the players that give him the best chance to win. Hard to think Ritchie isn't one of them when ready.

recent.text: The #Isles aren't practicing on the road & Pete DeBoer said Cal Ritchie's next step is taking contact. He can play for Hamilton on Friday to meet his minimum game requirement before being recalled. NYI won't need to make a roster move until he's ready.
